name: My fated Alpha: Rejected and Reclaimed
original_name: My fated Alpha: Rejected and Reclaimed
overview: Sophia suffered domestic abuse at the hands of her father, Antony, since a very young age. As an adult, Sophia encountered a paranoid and abusive partner, Gordon, who eventually pushed her off a cliff. Miraculously, Sophia survived and was rescued by Alpha Bernard, who had recently lost his partner. After being rescued, Sophia decided to move forward despite the doubts and pushbacks. Antony and Gordern, in an attempt to cover up their crimes, had since been planning to take Sophie out. Fate intertwined, Sophia and Bernard became partners. With Bernard's love and encouragement, Sophia not only overcame her inner fears, but also discovered her powerful abilities as the white wolf. With Bernard's assistance, she defeated Antony and Gordern, and ultimately became the queen.
